slides.headline: Sample: a platform fee plus a variable rate on approved volume, with the first block included.
slides.subline: Sample sub-line: one flat platform fee plus a percentage of approved volume above the included block, pooled across the five markets.

left.title: TRANSACTION FEE
left.sub: A percentage of the month's approved volume above the included block, pooled across Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia and Bolivia

rows.label: TRANCHE 1
rows.range: $0 to $1M a month above the block

left.note: No setup fee. No fixed fee per transaction. Declines and card verification attempts cost nothing. Each tranche applies only to the volume inside it.

middle.title: PLATFORM FEE
middle.sub: $90,000 a year. This is what covers the stack.

addons.title: ADD-ONS
addons.sub: Billed on usage, on top of the fees above.

middle.foot: Every integration maintained by Yuno. Adding a provider or a local rail later is a routing change, not a new fee.

right.title: WHAT IT MEANS FOR CARRY1ST
right.sub: At a $10 average ticket, successful transactions a month (sample numbers for the layout test)
right.callout: Sample: $0.061 all-in per successful transaction at the run rate, 0.61% of volume, falling as volume grows.
right.paragraph: Sample paragraph: Brazil first at launch volume costs the platform fee alone. Add-ons are billed on usage and are not in these totals.

slides.source: 3 year term, rates locked, tranches reviewed annually as volume grows. All figures in USD. Sample layout, not a quote.
